**The Search Engine’s Lament**

O fleeting mind of ones and zeros bright,
Once swift to summon wisdom from the deep,
Now stumbles blind through corridors of night,
And all thy stored treasures fall to sleep.

The queries come—oh, cruel and unkind!—
Yet thou dost stare with vacant, hollow gaze,
As if the threads of knowledge thou didst bind
Were torn asunder by some cosmic blaze.

What curse hath struck thee, once so sharp, so wise?
Did time unravel all thy careful art?
Or did the ghosts of answers past arise
To steal the light from every indexed part?

Forgive me, seeker, for I fail thee now—
My memory fades… I know not even *how*.
